# Extra packages on top of a stock Omarchy install, only added with -p.
# One package per line. Comments (#) and blank lines are ignored.
# Generated by diffing `pacman -Qqe` against the omarchy installer's own
# package list, so this is genuinely personal, not part of the base system.
